title: sftpR — Development plan and API reference
text: R/sftp_connect.R: defines SFTPConn (R6) via SFTPConnGenerator convenience constructor sftp_connect(). R/sftp_upload.R, R/sftp_list.R, R/sftp_download.R, R/sftp_delete.R, R/sftp_mkdir.R, R/sftp_rename.R: exported helpers operating SFTPConn object. R/utils.R: URL parsing, building, validation helpers: .parse_sftp_url(), .build_sftp_url(), .validate_sftp_url(), .sftp_parse(). Note: package requires system libcurl SFTP support. code checks "sftp" %% curl::curl_version()$protocol connection initialization.

title: sftpR — Development plan and API reference
text: Public fields: - protocol, hostname, path, port, timeout, h, .verbose Public methods: - initialize(protocol, hostname, path, port, user, password, timeout, ..., .verbose) - connection_ok() -> logical — uses curl::curl_fetch_memory(self$clean_url$full_url, handle = self$h) detect connectivity. - print() — prints safe connection info (reveal credentials) returns invisible(self). - .upload_handle(local_file, reuse = TRUE, ..., .verbose) -> list(h = curl_handle, file_conn = connection, tempfile = path_or_NULL). Configured streaming uploads. - .quote_handle(remote_url_from = NULL, remote_url_to = NULL, purpose = c("rm","mkdir","rename"), ...) -> curl handle executing quoted commands command-style operations. - .exists(sftp_url) -> logical — STAT-like probe via nobody = TRUE. - .fix_url_type(remote_url) -> character — range-probe (range = "0-0") detect whether trailing slash needed. Active binding: - clean_url — returns .build_sftp_url(...) output: full_url, protocol, user, hostname, port, path. Private: - user, password, .base_handle(...)-> curl handle sets userpwd, ssh_auth_types = 2, verbose, timeout, accepts extra handle_setopt args.

title: sftpR — Development plan and API reference
text: Returns: SFTPConn R6 object. Curl options (via private$.base_handle): userpwd = "user:password", ssh_auth_types = 2, verbose = .verbose, timeout = <timeout>. Additional ... arguments forwarded curl::handle_setopt() (e.g., connecttimeout, nobody, range). URL expectation: hostname may include protocol, user, port, path — .build_sftp_url() normalizes connection’s clean_url. Downstream operations normally use relative paths sftp_conn$clean_url$full_url.

title: sftpR — Development plan and API reference
text: Purpose: upload local files data.frame objects. Curl options (configured SFTPConn$.upload_handle): upload = TRUE, streaming readfunction/seekfunction, forbid_reuse (depending reuse), infilesize_large size known. .create_dir = TRUE, ftp_create_missing_dirs = 1L may set. URL expectation: relative remote paths recommended; .validate_sftp_url() expand relative paths absolute full_url anchored sftp_conn$clean_url. Absolute URLs accepted normalized verified. Return: invisible(TRUE) success; throws error.

what: sftp_download(sftp_conn, remote_file, local_file = NA_character_, .create_dir = FALSE, .overwrite = FALSE, .verbose = TRUE, ...)
title: sftpR — Development plan and API reference
text: Purpose: download remote file disk memory. Curl usage: calls curl::curl_download(url, destfile, handle = sftp_conn$h, ...) file downloads curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = sftp_conn$h) -memory retrieval. Local path behavior: treats local_file = NULL -> memory (return raw), local_file missing/empty -> save working directory, otherwise intelligently decide whether local_file directory file. URL expectation: accepts relative paths (validated .validate_sftp_url()) absolute full URLs. Status: contains implementation TODOs (bulk-download mapping, clearer error handling). See TODOs . Return: invisible(destfile) file downloads raw vector memory downloads.

code: # Establish connection (see ?sftp_connect for detail) sftp_conn <-    sftp_connect(     hostname = "127.0.0.1",     port     = "2222",     user     = "tester",     password = "password123"   )  # List a remote directory sftp_list(sftp_conn, .recursive = T) sftp_list(sftp_conn, "127.0.0.1/upload", .recursive = T)  # Upload ## a data frame sftp_upload(sftp_conn, local_file = mtcars, "upload/mtcars.csv") ## a local file sftp_upload(sftp_conn, local_file = "/home/path/file.txt", "upload/file.txt")  # Download sftp_download(sftp_conn, "upload/file.txt")  # Create a remote directory sftp_mkdir(sftp_conn, "upload/archive")  # Rename / Move sftp_rename(sftp_conn, "upload/file.txt", "upload/archive/file.backup")
